item.name: Observation Haki
item.levelingRoute: Levels through combat use while active
item.description: The first Haki players typically acquire. Observation Haki starts with 5 dodges and adds +1 dodge per 10 levels, reaching a maximum of 10 dodges at Level 50. Purchased from the Observation Master NPC on Desert Island for 250,000 Cash and 300 Gems.

stats.max_effect: Maximum 10 dodges (5 base + 5 × 10-level bonuses). Near-perfect evasion against predictable attacks.

item.acquisition: After purchasing, Observation Haki levels up automatically through combat use. Keep fighting with it active and it will gain experience passively — no separate leveling mechanic is required.
item.unlock: After purchasing, Observation Haki levels up automatically through combat use. Keep fighting with it active and it will gain experience passively — no separate leveling mechanic is required.

item.name: Armament Haki
item.requirements: Defeat 150 NPCs, hit 65 Z-key attacks, and land 750 punches
item.levelingRoute: Levels through combat use while active
item.description: The core offensive Haki of the game. Armament Haki increases damage by 25% at the base level, scaling to +75% damage at max level 100 (each level adds +0.5%). Unlocked via the Haki Master NPC on Snow Island — the questline requires defeating 150 NPCs, hitting 65 Z-key attacks, and landing 750 punches.

stats.max_effect: +75% damage at level 100 (max level per Discord FAQ: base 25% + 0.5% × 100 levels).

item.acquisition: After purchasing, Armament Haki levels up automatically through combat use. Keep fighting with it active and it will gain experience passively — no separate leveling mechanic is required.
item.unlock: After purchasing, Armament Haki levels up automatically through combat use. Keep fighting with it active and it will gain experience passively — no separate leveling mechanic is required.

item.name: Conqueror's Haki
item.unlockRoute: Conqueror Haki Trainer on Shibuya Station
item.requirements: Armament Lv. 40, Observation Lv. 25, Ascension Lv. 5, and 1 Conqueror Fragment
item.levelingRoute: Levels through combat use after unlock
item.description: The rarest and most prestigious Haki. Conqueror's Haki grants a permanent +1% damage increase per level (max 35 levels = +35% total damage as of Massive Update March 25, 2026 — raised from 25). Unlocked from the Conqueror Haki Trainer NPC on Shibuya Station. Prerequisites: Armament Haki Lv 40 + Observation Haki Lv 25 + Ascension Lv 5 + 1 Conqueror Fragment.

stats.max_effect: +35% permanent damage at max level (35 levels × +1% each). Cap raised from 25 in Massive Update (March 25, 2026).

item.acquisition: After purchasing, Conqueror's Haki levels up automatically through combat use. Keep fighting with it active and it will gain experience passively — no separate leveling mechanic is required.
item.unlock: After purchasing, Conqueror's Haki levels up automatically through combat use. Keep fighting with it active and it will gain experience passively — no separate leveling mechanic is required.
